steps.name: environment
steps.description: Validate node and npm presence and versions, check sudo availability, and write an idempotent /etc/profile.d script that persistently sets NODE_ENV=development in a conservative way (only for interactive shells and when explicitly requested) and provides a lazy helper to add npm global bin to PATH at runtime. Avoid executing node/npm during file creation.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/stock-insights-analyzer-234320-237759/stock_analyzer_frontend"
# Verify sudo available
if ! command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "sudo missing; required to write /etc/profile.d" >&2; exit 2; fi
# Verify node and npm exist and meet minimal version
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "node not found; ensure nodejs >=16 is installed" >&2; exit 2; }
command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "npm not found; ensure npm available" >&2; exit 2; }
node_ver=$(node -v 2>/dev/null || true)
node_major=$(echo "$node_ver" | sed -E 's/^v?([0-9]+).*/\1/' || echo "0")
if [ "${node_major:-0}" -lt 16 ]; then echo "node >=16 required, found ${node_ver:-unknown}" >&2; exit 2; fi
npm_ver=$(npm -v 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
# minimal npm check: require npm >=7
npm_major=$(echo "$npm_ver" | cut -d. -f1)
if [ "${npm_major:-0}" -lt 7 ]; then echo "npm >=7 recommended, found $npm_ver" >&2; exit 2; fi
# Write safe, idempotent profile.d without expanding runtime commands at write-time
sudo tee /etc/profile.d/stock_analyzer_node.sh >/dev/null <<'EOF'
# stock_analyzer frontend persistent env (written by automated setup)
# Export NODE_ENV=development for interactive shells only to avoid surprising CI/system accounts.
if [ -n "${PS1-}" ] || [ -n "${SSH_CONNECTION-}" ]; then
  export NODE_ENV=development
fi
# Helper: add npm global bin to PATH lazily at runtime (no node/npm calls at file-creation)
__stock_analyzer_add_npm_global_bin() {
  if [ -n "${STOCK_NPM_BIN_ADDED-}" ]; then return 0; fi
  STOCK_NPM_BIN_ADDED=1
  # common static locations
  for p in "/usr/local/bin" "$HOME/.npm-global/bin"; do
    [ -d "$p" ] && PATH="$p:$PATH" && export PATH && return 0
  done
  # runtime: if npm available compute bin
  if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    npm_bin=$(npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || true)
    [ -n "$npm_bin" ] && PATH="$npm_bin:$PATH" && export PATH
  fi
}
EOF
sudo chmod 0755 /etc/profile.d/stock_analyzer_node.sh
# Source for current session if possible (non-fatal)
. /etc/profile.d/stock_analyzer_node.sh || true
exit 0

steps.name: dependencies
steps.description: Install project dependencies deterministically. Use yarn if yarn.lock exists, npm ci if package-lock.json exists. If no lockfile, perform targeted install of missing core deps and only install typescript locally if project requires it and no suitable system tsc is available. Capture logs to a temporary file and surface them on failure to aid debugging while keeping successful runs quiet.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/stock-generation/stock-insights-analyzer-234320-237759/stock_analyzer_frontend"
# Use authoritative workspace
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/stock-insights-analyzer-234320-237759/stock_analyzer_frontend"
cd "$WS"
[ -f package.json ] || { echo "package.json missing; run scaffold first" >&2; exit 3; }
LOG=$(mktemp /tmp/stock_deps.XXXX)
PM="npm"
if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then PM="yarn"; elif [ -f package-lock.json ]; then PM="npm"; fi
# Detect TypeScript intent
is_ts_project=0
[ -f tsconfig.json ] && is_ts_project=1 || true
if [ "$is_ts_project" -eq 0 ]; then
  has_ts=$(node -e "const j=require('./package.json'); console.log((j.devDependencies&&j.devDependencies.typescript)|| (j.dependencies&&j.dependencies.typescript)?1:0);")
  [ "$has_ts" = "1" ] && is_ts_project=1 || true
fi
# If lockfile present use reproducible install
if [ "$PM" = "yarn" ] && [ -f yarn.lock ]; then
  yarn install --silent --non-interactive >"$LOG" 2>&1 || { cat "$LOG" >&2; rm -f "$LOG"; exit 4; }
elif [ "$PM" = "npm" ] && [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --quiet >"$LOG" 2>&1 || { cat "$LOG" >&2; rm -f "$LOG"; exit 4; }
else
  # No lockfile: ensure core deps present in package.json; install missing ones
  need_install=()
  core=(react react-dom react-scripts)
  for pkg in "${core[@]}"; do
    present=$(node -e "const j=require('./package.json'); const has=(j.dependencies&&j.dependencies['$pkg'])||(j.devDependencies&&j.devDependencies['$pkg']); console.log(has?1:0);")
    [ "$present" != "1" ] && need_install+=("$pkg") || true
  done
  # Typescript: only install locally if project indicates TS and no system tsc present
  if [ "$is_ts_project" -eq 1 ]; then
    if command -v tsc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "system tsc available; skipping local typescript install" > /dev/null
    else
      need_install+=('typescript' '@types/react' '@types/react-dom')
    fi
  fi
  if [ ${#need_install[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
    if [ "$PM" = "yarn" ]; then
      yarn add --silent --non-interactive "${need_install[@]}" >"$LOG" 2>&1 || { cat "$LOG" >&2; rm -f "$LOG"; exit 4; }
    else
      npm i --no-audit --no-fund --quiet "${need_install[@]}" >"$LOG" 2>&1 || { cat "$LOG" >&2; rm -f "$LOG"; exit 4; }
    fi
  else
    rm -f "$LOG"
  fi
fi
# Ensure scripts exist
node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='package.json';const j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p));j.scripts=j.scripts||{}; if(!j.scripts.start) j.scripts.start='react-scripts start'; if(!j.scripts.build) j.scripts.build='react-scripts build'; if(!j.scripts.test) j.scripts.test='react-scripts test --watchAll=false'; fs.writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(j,null,2));"
exit 0

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# Minimal Jest smoke test writer and runner (CI mode). Uses workspace from container info.
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/stock-insights-analyzer-234320-237759/stock_analyzer_frontend"
cd "$WS"
# Detect TS: tsconfig.json or typescript in package.json
is_ts=0
[ -f tsconfig.json ] && is_ts=1 || true
if [ "$is_ts" -eq 0 ] && [ -f package.json ]; then
  has_ts=$(node -e "try{const j=require('./package.json'); console.log((j.devDependencies&&j.devDependencies.typescript)|| (j.dependencies&&j.dependencies.typescript)?1:0);}catch(e){console.log(0)}")
  [ "$has_ts" = "1" ] && is_ts=1 || true
fi
mkdir -p src/__tests__
# Write test only if missing or content differs (idempotent)
if [ "$is_ts" -eq 1 ]; then
  out=src/__tests__/smoke.test.tsx
  cat > "$out" <<'TS'
import React from 'react';
import App from '../App';
test('App renders (TS)', () => { expect(App).toBeDefined(); });
TS
else
  out=src/__tests__/smoke.test.js
  cat > "$out" <<'JS'
const React = require('react');
let App = null;
try { App = require('../App').default || require('../App'); } catch(e) { App = null; }
test('App exports a component', ()=>{ expect(App).toBeDefined(); });
JS
fi
# Prepare log capture
LOG=$(mktemp /tmp/stock_test.XXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$LOG"' EXIT
# Choose test runner: prefer yarn when yarn.lock exists
if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then
  CI=true yarn test --watchAll=false >"$LOG" 2>&1 || { cat "$LOG" >&2; exit 5; }
else
  # Use npm script; ensure tests run in CI mode and disable watch
  CI=true npm run test --silent -- --watchAll=false >"$LOG" 2>&1 || { cat "$LOG" >&2; exit 5; }
fi
# Success: clean up log and exit 0
rm -f "$LOG"
exit 0

steps.name: dev-server-start
steps.description: Start the react-scripts development server (react-scripts start) bound to HOST=0.0.0.0 and validate it listens on configured PORT. Start in its own session and ensure clean termination by killing the process group. This verifies requirement for dev server on 0.0.0.0 in container dev mode.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/stock-insights-analyzer-234320-237759/stock_analyzer_frontend"
cd "$WS"
HOST="${HOST:-0.0.0.0}"
PORT="${PORT:-3000}"
LOG=$(mktemp /tmp/stock_start.XXXX)
# Start dev server in new session so we can kill whole PGID later
setsid sh -c "HOST=$HOST PORT=$PORT npm run start" >"$LOG" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
# Determine PGID for the backgrounded process
sleep 1
PGID=$(ps -o pgid= -p "$PID" | tr -d ' ' || true)
if [ -z "$PGID" ]; then
  echo "failed to determine PGID; see $LOG" >&2; cat "$LOG" >&2 || true; kill "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; exit 6
fi
# Poll for readiness on localhost and HOST
ok=0; i=0; max=60
while [ $i -lt $max ]; do
  if curl -sSf "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/" >/dev/null 2>&1 || ( [ "$HOST" != "0.0.0.0" ] && curl -sSf "http://$HOST:$PORT/" >/dev/null 2>&1 ); then ok=1; break; fi
  sleep 1; i=$((i+1))
